scope: post-v1 descriptive cost/availability diagnostic; no paid task policy, no new independent test
UL_rule: native task first, at most one pending latest-summary attempt per agent per slot and only within original residual budget; retransmission costs paid; expiry/supersession explicit
DL_rule: encoded ACK broadcast contains(sender,tx_slot,success) and CRC; encoded complete latest snapshot has count/header/CRC; separate per-recipient erasure; ACK not free; earliest receiver use=t+1+delay
information_rule: cache never used by task policy; cache age/decode depends only on delivered frames; world/eval leakage prohibited
clock: fixed native H0 task traces, original mission end censors pending/flight, no fictitious post-mission radio opportunities
excludes: full matched-H rerun of native task packets
session/restart protocol beyond fixed mission namespace
